name: roll
about: The avatar lies down on the ground, rolls over and over a few times, then jumps up, brushes off the dust and cheers.
code:
me.feel('happy')
me.say({ en: 'Roll time!', fi: 'Kieritään!' })
yield* me.poseTo({ armL: { swing: Math.PI, bend: 0 }, armR: { swing: Math.PI, bend: 0 }, legL: { swing: 0 }, legR: { swing: 0 } }, 0.3)
yield* w.during(0.4, k => { me.pitch = -Math.PI / 2 * w.ease(k); me.y = me.radius * w.ease(k) })
const p = me.ahead(0, 1), sx = p.x - me.x, sz = p.z - me.z
const dir = Math.abs(me.x + sx * 3) < w.size && Math.abs(me.z + sz * 3) < w.size ? 1 : -1
w.sound('giggle')
yield* w.during(2.5, (k, dt) => {
  me.roll = dir * k * Math.PI * 6
  me.x = w.clamp(me.x + sx * dir * dt * 1.2, -w.size, w.size)
  me.z = w.clamp(me.z + sz * dir * dt * 1.2, -w.size, w.size)
  if (w.random() < 0.15) w.puff({ x: me.x, y: 0.05, z: me.z, kind: 'dust', count: 3 })
})
me.roll = 0
me.feel('silly')
yield* w.during(0.3, k => { me.pitch = -Math.PI / 2 * (1 - k); me.y = me.radius * (1 - k) })
me.pitch = 0; me.y = 0
yield* me.jump(0.5)
w.sound('whoosh')
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  yield* me.poseTo({ armR: { swing: 0.6, raise: -0.4, bend: 1 }, lean: 0.2 }, 0.15)
  w.puff({ at: me, kind: 'dust', count: 6 })
  yield* me.poseTo({ armR: { swing: 0.2, raise: 0.3, bend: 0.5 } }, 0.15)
}
me.feel('happy')
w.sound('yay')
me.say({ en: 'Hooray!', fi: 'Jippii!' })
yield* me.poseTo({ armL: { swing: 0, raise: 2.6 }, armR: { swing: 0, raise: 2.6 }, lean: 0 }, 0.25)
yield* me.jump(0.4)
yield* me.rest()
